title: SAVITRIBAI PHULE MULINCHE VASATIGRUH - CHIKHALDARA
heroText: Established in 1992 at Chikhaldara, Amravati CEO : Mr. Arun Sapkal, Maai's elder son Current Beneficiaries : 50
points: The organisation is working for a refuge to needy, destitute, Tribal girls.
The organization is doing some exemplary work in the remote areas.
Provide the basic necessities of food, shelter, cloth and medical care.
Motivates and supports needy and tribal girls to get educated.
